weaknesses: The experimental results lack clarity in presenting the statistical significance of the comparisons made.
Some metrics used for evaluation are not clearly defined or justified in terms of their relevance to the claims made.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the proposed method compared to existing approaches.
strengths: The theoretical framework provided for the optimization problem is well-structured and offers a novel approach to decoding.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method across multiple metrics and datasets.
The use of human evaluation alongside automatic metrics provides a comprehensive assessment of the generated text quality.
